issues.on_page: Other financing sources (uses): Gain on sale of equipment 5,000; Gain on involuntary disposal 185,994; Note payment (14,864); Bond payment (60,000); Total 116,130
issues.issue: [fixed] Note payment 14,864 and Bond payment 60,000 are debt principal repayments printed below Total expenditures. Under the outside_printed_total rule they belong in disbursements (debt service principal, outside_printed_total: true), not netted into other_financing. With them moved out, other_financing would be 190,994 and the identity still holds.
